purpose: Expose the exact combinatorial object hidden by the rank-two factorization of each mixed degree-three P0 block and close the tempting weighted-linear-matroid-parity shortcut. The surviving clause constraint is exactly a rainbow/color partition constraint on a disjoint union of P4/P3 components.

local_rank2_factorization.left_dependence: Among L,M,R, the only nontrivial parallel pair in U is {L,M}.
local_rank2_factorization.right_dependence: Among L,M,R, the only nontrivial parallel pair in V is {M,R}.
local_rank2_factorization.meaning: The exact five-state sign-consistency relation is common independence of two rank-two partition/linear matroids. Represent each occurrence o as an edge joining its left parallel-class resource to its right parallel-class resource. For L,M,R this is a three-edge path P4: L and R are disjoint, while M meets both.

global_rainbow_forest.graph: Take the disjoint union of the local occurrence-edge components over Boolean variables. Mixed degree-three variables give P4 components; mixed degree-two variables give P3 components; pure/single-sign remnants split into trivial matching resources in the same common-independence representation.
global_rainbow_forest.edge_color: Color each occurrence edge by its clause C(o).
global_rainbow_forest.matching_equivalence: A set of occurrence edges is a graph matching iff it is simultaneously independent in the two variable-side matroids, equivalently iff it is sign-consistent.
global_rainbow_forest.rainbow_equivalence: A matching is rainbow iff it uses at most one occurrence from each clause. Therefore a rainbow matching of size m, where m is the number of clauses, uses exactly one edge of every clause color and is exactly a sign-consistent one-witness-per-clause transversal.
global_rainbow_forest.theorem: For every normalized bounded-occurrence 2/3-CNF F, F is satisfiable iff the associated edge-colored linear forest has a rainbow matching of size |Clauses(F)|.
global_rainbow_forest.canonical_tovey_image: In the standard copy-cycle normalization each copy variable has exactly three mixed-polarity occurrences, so the underlying graph is a disjoint union of P4 components. Original 3-clauses and implication 2-clauses are colors of size three and two respectively; because clause positions use distinct copy variables, the coloring is proper.

weighted_matroid_parity_boundary.positive_donor: Lovasz linear matroid parity, and the deterministic weighted algorithm of Iwata-Kobayashi, optimize additive weights in polynomial time for linearly represented matroids.
weighted_matroid_parity_boundary.missing_constraint: The clause requirement is not an additive weight; it is a third partition/color independence constraint forbidding two selected edges of one clause color.
weighted_matroid_parity_boundary.literature_control: Le and Pfender prove Rainbow Matching NP-complete/APX-hard even for properly edge-colored P5-free linear forests, with hardness surviving very small path components and color multiplicity at most two. Thus the forest geometry alone does not license a polynomial rainbow solver.
weighted_matroid_parity_boundary.scope: This literature result is an anti-loop control, not a proof that every conceivable nonlocal algebraic use of the source colors fails. The exact NP-hardness of the JANUS source subclass already follows from the SAT iff rainbow theorem above together with the polynomial normalization.

killed: Invoke weighted linear matroid parity after the rank-two variable factorization while treating clause distinctness as if it were an ordinary scalar weight.
Claim that disjoint-union-of-short-paths structure by itself makes the remaining color constraint polynomial.
Drop the clause partition layer after converting the two variable layers to matching resources.
not_killed: A nonlocal algebraic cancellation that eliminates the color partition globally without enumerating color transversals.
A source-specific blossom/augmentation theorem that uses the joint Tovey color-cycle incidence, not merely the uncolored forest.
Topology-changing polynomial gadgets with exact witness lifting.

next_target.directive: Treat the clause color layer as the only remaining obstruction after exact rank-two factorization. Search for a polynomial-size nonlocal operation using the special Tovey incidence between P4 variable components and 2/3-clause colors. Do not retry scalar weights, generic matroid parity, generic rainbow matching, or local conflict penalties.

no exponential color subset state, assignment phase enumeration, interpolation grid, or oracle
